transport: provider-neutral logical tasks; not an SDK request body
completeness: not-evaluated; local questions cannot measure missing claims
referencePolicy: separate versioned candidate references; human adjudication requires evidence and a new reference revision
deadlinePolicy: future dispatcher must use one monotonic run deadline and min(remaining run time, 60s) per attempt; offline replay records deadlines, does not execute timers

comparisonPolicy.A-C: same source/candidate/whole instruction; binary task matched, answer formats and abstention differ
comparisonPolicy.A-B: decomposition plus granularity, aggregation and question count change together
comparisonPolicy.A-D: task, target selection and answer space change together; no primitive-only causal conclusion
comparisonPolicy.quality: no provider quality or case-level correctness claim from these offline fixtures
